title: Kenmore Dryer
contents_raw:
== Background ==

Sears introduced Kenmore in 1913 with Kenmore-branded sewing machines. In 1949, Kenmore released its first automatic electric clothes dryer. Kenmore dryers often come equipped with Wrinkle Guard and Sensor Dry technology.

== Identification ==

The model number can be found inside the dryer, around the drum or on the door. Common models include the 65132, 69133, and the 81382.

To accurately identify the specific features and manufacturing details of your Kenmore Dryer, it's essential to understand the model number designation. The model number consists of various parts, each indicating different aspects of the appliance, such as the source code, model year, and feature level.

=== Manufacturer Identification ===

Navigating the lineage of Kenmore appliances can often feel like a journey into a corporate labyrinth. Kenmore, a staple in American households, has its vast array of appliances manufactured by several leading companies, yet they all wear the Kenmore badge. This intricate dance of brands and models can leave consumers puzzled about the origins and makers of their household appliances.

Our table serves as a compass in this complex world, offering you a way to decode the model number of your Kenmore appliance with ease. == Understanding Kenmore Dryer Components ==

In the world of appliance repair and maintenance, knowledge of the individual components of gas or electric dryers is crucial. These appliances are essential in our daily lives, providing us with the means to dry our clothing. However, their complexity means that a wide variety of parts work together to ensure their proper function.

The following table categorizes the key components found in typical Kenmore electric or gas dryers. This breakdown aims to aid both repair professionals and enthusiasts in identifying parts, understanding their functions, and troubleshooting issues more efficiently. Whether you're performing routine maintenance or tackling a specific repair, this serves as a valuable resource for navigating the intricate world of laundry appliances.

{table
|width=100%
|format=20%l:80%l
|! Location
|! Parts
|--

| User Interface Board, Motor Control, Machine Control

}
